detailed_descriptions.en: A GRITTY, MATURE STORY Actors, writers, producers, are getting murdered one by one in cold blood. No one is safe. Who is pulling the strings behind these apparently unrelated murders? A VARIED AND REALISTIC CAST Double-dealing, backstabbing, betrayal. Nothing is what it seems in the world of stars. Take a peek behind the curtains, learn what's going on behind the glistering façade. Meet a varied cast of characters, discover their secrets and ambitions. But be careful... they may end up in a body bag. DEDUCTIVE GAMEPLAY Examine the crime scene, find clues, piece together what happened, find the culprit! Reveal what's the true reason behind these Confidential Killings .

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
A GRITTY, MATURE STORY

Actors, writers, producers, are getting murdered one by one in cold blood. No one is safe. Who is pulling the strings behind these apparently unrelated murders?

A VARIED AND REALISTIC CAST

Double-dealing, backstabbing, betrayal.

Nothing is what it seems in the world of stars. Take a peek behind the curtains, learn what's going on behind the glistering façade. Meet a varied cast of characters, discover their secrets and ambitions.

But be careful... they may end up in a body bag.

DEDUCTIVE GAMEPLAY

Examine the crime scene, find clues, piece together what happened, find the culprit! Reveal what's the true reason behind these Confidential Killings.
